name: VibeWave v2.4.1
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave v2.4.1 Update!

- 🎨 **Crystal Clear Update Button:** Update Now button ko high-contrast Royal Blue & Bold White text me design kiya gaya hai taaki bilkul saaf aur sundar dikhe!
- ✖️ **Notification Cut / Close Button:** Upar scroll down karke direct gana band karne (cut karne) ka option!
- 🎙️ **Voice Search & Assistant:** Bol kar gana search karein!
- ⚡ **Super Smooth 60-120 FPS:** Buttery smooth performance.
